summary.text: Lisa Mair is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 12th Worcester District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Meghan Kilcoyne.
She is an at-large member of the Berlin-Boylston Regional School District committee and advanced from the September 1, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Mair ran as an independent for the Massachusetts State Senate, 1st Worcester District, in 2022 and lost the general election to Democrat Robyn Kennedy, 72.8 percent to 26.1 percent.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Mair described herself as a small business owner and said she wanted to bridge the partisan divide, encourage prevention-focused public health, make it simpler and more affordable to run a small business in Massachusetts, and remove toxic chemicals from school lunches.
